warmup: One excluded case per method; the measured gated pipeline warms both its gate and native localizer.
method_order: Rotates by case within each four/five-method comparison.
timing: End-to-end per query, including all decisions, preprocessing, inference, decoding and parsing; excludes model loading, warm-up and result logging. Throughput is inverse mean latency, not batched throughput.

vqa.dataset: A-OKVQA validation with COCO val2017 images
vqa.choices: Four original answer choices in original order, mapped to A/B/C/D.
vqa.prompt_mapping: All methods explicitly pair label keys with their answer descriptions.
vqa.metric: Exact multiple-choice accuracy; invalid outputs count as incorrect.

localization.query: A specified category with zero or one annotated instance; other categories may be visible.
localization.positive_filter: Exactly one annotation of the queried category, noncrowd, with bbox width and height greater than one pixel.
localization.negative_filter: No annotation of the queried category; annotation incompleteness is a limitation.
localization.coordinate_protocol: Present/absent decision, then sequential x_min/y_min/x_max/y_max choices on a 0-1000 grid with step 25. Earlier predictions constrain valid later boundaries; a forced single remaining boundary skips inference.
localization.direct_box_baseline: One request generates the complete continuous normalized box or null, with a 100-token budget and no candidate boxes.
localization.localization_success: IoU >= 0.5 on all positive queries; misses count as failures.
localization.positive_mean_iou: Mean over all positives, including misses as zero.
localization.negative_false_positive_rate: Fraction of negative queries with a predicted object.
localization.f1: At IoU >= 0.5; a wrong positive box counts as both FP and FN.
localization.latency_reporting: Positive and negative p50 are separated because absence can exit early.
localization.grid_diagnostic: 96% of GT boxes rounded to the step-25 grid retain IoU >= 0.5. This is a diagnostic, not a formal performance upper bound.

exploratory_gated_localization.pipeline: Cached binary presence decision; invoke the same native box generator only when the gate chooses present.
exploratory_gated_localization.timing: Measured end-to-end, not composed from component timings.
exploratory_gated_localization.limitation: Selected after pilot inspection and evaluated on the same fixed sample; exploratory, without independent held-out confirmation.

json_evaluation.normalization: Optionally remove one complete outer Markdown JSON fence; then parse and require an exact allowed string label or valid bbox/null.
json_evaluation.comparability: This explicitly mapped prototype protocol differs from the earlier Imagenette JSON baseline.

memory: PyTorch allocator statistics include model tensors but exclude CUDA context, driver and desktop memory. Reserved memory may retain a prior method's allocation pool.
limitations: Small exploratory validation samples, not full benchmark scores or an independent held-out study.
One measured repetition per case; shared server CPU/I/O activity can affect latency.
Candidate probabilities are relative to supplied choices and are uncalibrated.
Coordinate selection, fence normalization and gated localization are experiment prototypes, not new public classifier APIs.
